R15: [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=11325239)

It was simply a contractual marriage, a marriage meant to produce a son, and there was no love between us. Then one day, Tae-Geom, who had been terrifyingly cold, began to change. The person who used to leave the master bedroom without a second thought after work now wanted to sleep in the same bed and brought me tickets to a concert by my favorite pianist.

Why was he suddenly acting like this?
My heart, which I'd thought dry, began to beat with renewed vigor.

Maybe, just maybe, I could live happily with him... I harbored such a foolish hope.
